t: Core Principles of Early Earthquake Warning Networks
title: Core Principles of Early Earthquake Warning Networks
provenance: Public research knowledge: documented developments, published research, and established technical references. Real, fact-checked records.
description: Four principles govern early earthquake warning networks. Principle 1: defense in depth: no single layer is trusted alone. Principle 2: privacy is a requirement: collect the minimum needed and protect it fiercely. Principle 3: detection without response is theater: alerts must reach someone empowered to act. Principle 4: every automated decision affecting people needs human accountability. The piece records show where each principle is enforced in hardware and software.

t: Build Plan: Making Early Earthquake Warning Networks Step by Step
title: Build Plan: Making Early Earthquake Warning Networks Step by Step
